- Identify what is fixed and what may vary, distinguish a single object from a parameterized family, and preserve the stated domain and measure for claims

## Parse choices literally
Before choosing, translate each option into its logical form. Mark the domain of every quantifier, any exceptional cases, and whether a clause asserts necessity, sufficiency
